title: Army Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit confirmed to Steinman

tellings.quote: Yeah, 47 to 50. And I that was first confirmed in 1986 to UFO researcher William Steinman.

plain: The claim is that the US Army had a small unit called the Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit, which it says existed from 1947 to 1950 to look into unexplained things in the sky. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells this on the show without naming a source, and says the unit's existence was first confirmed in 1986 to a UFO researcher named William Steinman, and ties it to a report and a field order from the unit. If true, the Army had its own UFO group from the very start of the modern UFO era.
